title: Certification Candidate Engine
purpose: Automatically identify READY inventory for certification waves by running structural readiness checks, identity validation, and governance compliance across all pack files.

structural.DL008_clean: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] must be empty per EV8
structural.DL026_clean: No empty ExplanationWrong fields at non-CorrectChoice positions
structural.DL021_clean: Distractor ExplanationWrong fields must be present
structural.correctChoice_present: CorrectChoice field must exist and be one of A/B/C/D
structural.explanation_present: ExplanationCorrect must be non-empty and >= 50 chars
structural.choices_complete: All 4 choices (A/B/C/D) must be present and non-empty

identity.gate_neg1_pass: Gate -1 identity validation must pass (no CC/Stem/EC missing)
identity.question_state_valid: question_state must be one of: Unprocessed, In Audit, Editorial Queue
identity.not_already_certified: Must not already be question_state: Certified

governance.rule2_compliant: No non-empty ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] per governance-guard Rule 2
governance.rule5_respected: Item not in a blocked batch (>30 items without BLOCK-AUTHORIZED)
governance.defect_manifest_clear: Not listed in DEFECT_MANIFEST_DL008_DL026.json as blocked

states.BLOCKED: Failed identity validation or has critical structural defects
states.REMEDIATE: Has known defects requiring fix before certification
states.READY: All gates pass — eligible for certification wave
states.CERTIFY: Quality Board approved — ready for certification action
